## Tensions Escalate Between US and Venezuela Amid Military Buildup

In the final week of November 2025, relations between the United States and Venezuela grew increasingly fraught as the Trump administration intensified its pressure on President Nicolás Maduro. The period was marked by a significant U.S. military presence in the Caribbean, warnings to air missions, and discussions of covert operations, culminating in a declaration by President Trump that Venezuelan airspace was closed.

The week began with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issuing a Notice to Air Missions (NOTAM) on November 22, 2025, warning of "heightened military activity" and potential hazards like GPS interference in Venezuelan airspace. [aljazeera.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyPnaMtyLrz0QEB-fNN2V1HjwEAvbNC8OemzYOF-hcLndMuND4kcvW99HOSS1kelnCnN-H7QZYIPFluvoGJV7a5Gc6ZTVEMhKud7eW-qMdPVVDePtZ__OE2k-SAl0DX6_aLtDArar-rEBuVMh4-HTYxV3IAN0GeZy4F3mv7qEMJTIKNIjS9p-k--91ik3jCAxWyRm4lCIB4w==) This advisory led several international airlines to cancel flights to the country. [fakti.bg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEbN49VEcy0RY5WJuAeVzEipjpBYEhJ87kSOedmkdnq37XlymEN68hFcIWXnFZxSj_j4SgUYOU8lduQtYnj8imgSNyHegKS1DYUUM0ASLm7hUD3icub16S4RVwP7Q_WVgT30UF2t_7HAP59cG1w1jVD_Q4YiN9vC-WEMySpSocxijqFsOFXcto=) The alert followed months of a U.S. military buildup in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific, ostensibly as part of a counter-narcotics campaign that resulted in numerous strikes on alleged drug boats and over 83 fatalities since September 2025. [aljazeera.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyPnaMtyLrz0QEB-fNN2V1HjwEAvbNC8OemzYOF-hcLndMuND4kcvW99HOSS1kelnCnN-H7QZYIPFluvoGJV7a5Gc6ZTVEMhKud7eW-qMdPVVDePtZ__OE2k-SAl0DX6_aLtDArar-rEBuVMh4-HTYxV3IAN0GeZy4F3mv7qEMJTIKNIjS9p-k--91ik3jCAxWyRm4lCIB4w==) [thecable.ng](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE-t0kPjQPE4xDGV8HEiZScd_YfSZu_Z_FUPjmvmMqnU2igxwwaNNG-LG3UQVSN_jWAeloY-pGBKAcj-NU7U5zxolXrfCAtiUhvgpPmsqH3CMoaFMl2sJEIgFfJJSVWh0wNC-wglaUwiQ-ubAIQJ3zMOncxq9e54zoESyZgXtuglQyn3lUWEIer8zOgGjDQJ5Lj2JPMYOF1cG2nxP0=)

Discussions within the Trump administration reportedly included the possibility of psychological warfare, such as dropping leaflets over Caracas to weaken Maduro's regime. [cbsnews.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHP_QTNvbrVNdmfGuQA29tYuPj8IfTDcbmFBHbKV4QWgj4uRdRH7Vr7IEzo8Y1Im68XA2Nc1a8ugawZH-gG9CTww1n3a5EPHz9pTWHL5YVWV-Do7lCPDOq2hr5OpLcr4yAeHejlQUimhWaMvYQCMQgUswg0uL2YsEP-7yIoh1BnctQXERih9TDwag==) These considerations came as President Trump publicly refused to rule out sending U.S. troops into Venezuela. [cbsnews.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHP_QTNvbrVNdmfGuQA29tYuPj8IfTDcbmFBHbKV4QWgj4uRdRH7Vr7IEzo8Y1Im68XA2Nc1a8ugawZH-gG9CTww1n3a5EPHz9pTWHL5YVWV-Do7lCPDOq2hr5OpLcr4yAeHejlQUimhWaMvYQCMQgUswg0uL2YsEP-7yIoh1BnctQXERih9TDwag==) The U.S. had already deployed the USS Gerald R. Ford aircraft carrier and other warships to the Caribbean for a mission dubbed "Southern Spear." [aljazeera.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyPnaMtyLrz0QEB-fNN2V1HjwEAvbNC8OemzYOF-hcLndMuND4kcvW99HOSS1kelnCnN-H7QZYIPFluvoGJV7a5Gc6ZTVEMhKud7eW-qMdPVVDePtZ__OE2k-SAl0DX6_aLtDArar-rEBuVMh4-HTYxV3IAN0GeZy4F3mv7qEMJTIKNIjS9p-k--91ik3jCAxWyRm4lCIB4w==)

The strained relations can be traced back to earlier in 2025, with the Trump administration revoking the temporary protected status for about 600,000 Venezuelans in the U.S., imposing tariffs on countries buying Venezuelan oil, and increasing the reward for Maduro's arrest to $50 million. [aljazeera.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyPnaMtyLrz0QEB-fNN2V1HjwEAvbNC8OemzYOF-hcLndMuND4kcvW99HOSS1kelnCnN-H7QZYIPFluvoGJV7a5Gc6ZTVEMhKud7eW-qMdPVVDePtZ__OE2k-SAl0DX6_aLtDArar-rEBuVMh4-HTYxV3IAN0GeZy4F3mv7qEMJTIKNIjS9p-k--91ik3jCAxWyRm4lCIB4w==) [behorizon.org](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFLsaW_Dtb1mrnxSnZag0k3tp6f1CKQ9Q6tG841q2D2MlqXl3pNTu5dMXx8oTlX0rerpawwsgH6gX-G66bW06WX4B_CGZgl-BEYS82ivK-kgW2rmRXxo2w1WU4TNGJINBeCrTVIIwnM1c8PAgkpT_B-UQHnb9pQHAI7XD89JSU8ZKM2) Tensions had been high for over two decades, but escalated dramatically during Trump's second term over disputes related to oil, U.S. sanctions, and Venezuela's political leadership. [britannica.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_piV5o_0dRxS5UVM-06rn0JRV-O_LLJv7VkvcXBjk7fTaxLr19kSAjNRjlYXA-U6gAlF4V2z7jrjzpP4iCiCG6Ic-p_7u6RUfIJUXvOTHEFugw-DVaLiwbota8yZSq6Ko5ESMHmpE3ZFm-jsSeXunBU2TeR3kOHA5AmGtEZtSdtB8ftcI184a_anSyeTWbnjAt9xqeg==)

The week concluded with a significant escalation on November 29, 2025, when President Trump announced via social media that Venezuelan airspace was to be considered "CLOSED IN ITS ENTIRETY." [britannica.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_piV5o_0dRxS5UVM-06rn0JRV-O_LLJv7VkvcXBjk7fTaxLr19kSAjNRjlYXA-U6gAlF4V2z7jrjzpP4iCiCG6Ic-p_7u6RUfIJUXvOTHEFugw-DVaLiwbota8yZSq6Ko5ESMHmpE3ZFm-jsSeXunBU2TeR3kOHA5AmGtEZtSdtB8ftcI184a_anSyeTWbnjAt9xqeg==) The Venezuelan government condemned the move, with Foreign Minister Yván Gil labeling it a "hostile, unilateral, and arbitrary act" and a "colonialist threat." [britannica.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_piV5o_0dRxS5UVM-06rn0JRV-O_LLJv7VkvcXBjk7fTaxLr19kSAjNRjlYXA-U6gAlF4V2z7jrjzpP4iCiCG6Ic-p_7u6RUfIJUXvOTHEFugw-DVaLiwbota8yZSq6Ko5ESMHmpE3ZFm-jsSeXunBU2TeR3kOHA5AmGtEZtSdtB8ftcI184a_anSyeTWbnjAt9xqeg==) This declaration was the culmination of a period of intense pressure that included a series of lethal boat strikes by the U.S. military in the preceding months. [britannica.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_piV5o_0dRxS5UVM-06rn0JRV-O_LLJv7VkvcXBjk7fTaxLr19kSAjNRjlYXA-U6gAlF4V2z7jrjzpP4iCiCG6Ic-p_7u6RUfIJUXvOTHEFugw-DVaLiwbota8yZSq6Ko5ESMHmpE3ZFm-jsSeXunBU2TeR3kOHA5AmGtEZtSdtB8ftcI184a_anSyeTWbnjAt9xqeg==) In response to what it called "mounting threats," the Maduro government had requested an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council in October 2025. [britannica.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_piV5o_0dRxS5UVM-06rn0JRV-O_LLJv7VkvcXBjk7fTaxLr19kSAjNRjlYXA-U6gAlF4V2z7jrjzpP4iCiCG6Ic-p_7u6RUfIJUXvOTHEFugw-DVaLiwbota8yZSq6Ko5ESMHmpE3ZFm-jsSeXunBU2TeR3kOHA5AmGtEZtSdtB8ftcI184a_anSyeTWbnjAt9xqeg==)

grounding_supports.segment_text: The week began with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issuing a Notice to Air Missions (NOTAM) on November 22, 2025, warning of "heightened military activity" and potential hazards like GPS interference in Venezuelan airspace.
This advisory led several international airlines to cancel flights to the country.

The alert followed months of a U.S. military buildup in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific, ostensibly as part of a counter-narcotics campaign that resulted in numerous strikes on alleged drug boats and over 83 fatalities since September 2025.
Discussions within the Trump administration reportedly included the possibility of psychological warfare, such as dropping leaflets over Caracas to weaken Maduro's regime.
These considerations came as President Trump publicly refused to rule out sending U.S. troops into Venezuela.
Ford aircraft carrier and other warships to the Caribbean for a mission dubbed "Southern Spear."

The strained relations can be traced back to earlier in 2025, with the Trump administration revoking the temporary protected status for about 600,000 Venezuelans in the U.S., imposing tariffs on countries buying Venezuelan oil, and increasing the reward for Maduro's arrest to $50 million.
Tensions had been high for over two decades, but escalated dramatically during Trump's second term over disputes related to oil, U.S. sanctions, and Venezuela's political leadership.
The week concluded with a significant escalation on November 29, 2025, when President Trump announced via social media that Venezuelan airspace was to be considered "CLOSED IN ITS ENTIRETY."
The Venezuelan government condemned the move, with Foreign Minister Yván Gil labeling it a "hostile, unilateral, and arbitrary act" and a "colonialist threat."
This declaration was the culmination of a period of intense pressure that included a series of lethal boat strikes by the U.S. military in the preceding months.
In response to what it called "mounting threats," the Maduro government had requested an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council in October 2025.
